ledger.x: 1924, 12 October: "The Moldavian Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic was established inside the Ukrainian SSR, on 12 October 1924", with 11 raions on the left bank of the Dniester; it "gained several additional territories, including the Balta district".
1924, 12 October: "The Moldavian Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic was established inside the Ukrainian SSR, on 12 October 1924".
1929: the seat moves from Balta (provisional capital 1924-1929) to Tiraspol (1929-1940).
1940, 2 August: the Moldavian SSR "was established that day from six Bessarabian counties plus the westernmost part of the MASSR, about 4,118 km2", "effectively dissolving it".
1940, 2 August: page silent on the rest of the territory; the infobox lists Moldova and Ukraine as the land today, so the rest is drawn as returning to the Ukrainian SSR.
1940, 2 August: the Moldavian SSR is formed from six Bessarabian counties and the westernmost part of the autonomous republic, "effectively dissolving it".
1940, 2 August: "the Supreme Soviet unanimously approved the dissolution of the old Moldavian ASSR".

certainty.note: The page lists the 1924 oblast districts but no raions for the autonomous republic; its area grew from 7,516 km2 (1926) to 8,288 km2 (1939).
